# DSH Studio v0.9.15

## Changes

- Rebuild the dark desktop hierarchy around a black navigation rail, an `#181818` workspace, `#212121` work surfaces, and inverse selected controls. The light theme uses the corresponding surface relationships instead of a flat single-surface layout.
- Standardize the shell on a 264 px sidebar and 36 px title bar, keep the mode selector centered, expose the current page in the title bar, and use 20 px content headings.
- Contain the plugin marketplace within a 1040 px work surface and use 780 px reading widths for Settings, About, and Remote. Sidebar rows, tabs, theme controls, and page actions now share the same compact geometry and typography.
- Keep inputs, selectors, and selected states aligned with OpenAI Sans and the neutral surface system across both themes and the compact 744 px window.
- Replace all six English and Chinese README screenshots and animations with clean `1120×700` captures of the updated interface.

## Fixes and polish

- Update the plugin-install demonstration for the current preview-token, security-review, and confirmation flow instead of failing against the obsolete direct-install mock contract.
- End the demonstration on Installed 3 after the marketplace gained a separate Installable tab.
- Keep the browser-control connection overlay outside the application capture and validate PNG data and dimensions before APNG encoding.

## Installation and limitations

- Upgrade in place or use the in-app updater. Full includes offline dependencies; Lite downloads them when first needed.
- OpenAI Sans Regular, Medium, and Semibold remain bundled with both Lite and Full; no system font installation is required.

## Verification

- Local production build, lint, 281 frontend tests at 95.1% statement coverage, 59 packaging tests, 408 Rust tests, accessibility checks, public-contract checks, and bilingual documentation checks passed.
- Browser checks covered dark and light themes, the open selector, standard and 744 px layouts, all three OpenAI Sans faces, zero horizontal overflow, and a clean error console after a full reload.
- All six documentation assets were verified at `1120×700`: 34 frames per plugin animation, 12 frames per remote-pairing animation, and one frame per console image.
- The release pipeline validates Lite and Full packages on Linux, Windows, and macOS, including an in-place Windows upgrade and clean uninstall, before publishing checksums and the signed updater manifest.
